description:
[Admin] Get a merchant status snapshot: credit balances, subscription, pending-work counts, candidate/result totals, and invitation headroom.

Status snapshot for a merchant: interview-credit balances, subscription type/status, pending-work counts (undecided / ongoing / uncredited interviews), candidate & result totals with 14-day history, and invitation headroom. Scoped to your token's merchant (or a merchant_id override for admins / sub-merchant operators). Also echoes the caller's profile_id and default_merchant_id from the token, plus the effective merchant_id.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

name: get_merchant_status

candidates.description: Total candidates (non-archived profile_interview rows) for the merchant.

candidates_history.description: Daily new-candidate counts for the last 14 days, most recent first.

credits_interview_extra.description: Extra (top-up) interview credits available on top of the monthly allowance.

credits_interview_monthly_limit.description: Monthly interview-credit allowance for the current plan.

default_merchant_id.description: The caller's home merchant id pinned in the JWT (app_metadata.merchant_id). Null if the token carries no merchant.

definitions_active.description: Count of active interview + position definitions.

interview_result_history.description: Daily new-interview-result counts for the last 14 days, most recent first.

interview_results.description: Total non-archived interview results for the merchant.

interviews_undecided.description: Completed interviews awaiting a recruiter decision.

interviews_without_credits.description: Completed interviews that have not yet consumed a credit.

invitations_available.description: Remaining invitations this period. Null for unlimited (Special) plans.

invitations_limit.description: Maximum invitations allowed this period (4x available credits). Null for unlimited (Special) plans.

invitations_sent.description: Interview invitations sent during the current subscription period.

merchant_id.description: The merchant this status is scoped to — the default_merchant_id unless an admin / sub-merchant operator overrode it via the merchant_id query param.

profile_id.description: The calling user's profile id (auth user id), taken from the JWT.

subscription_status.description: Subscription status (e.g. active, past_due, canceled). Null when no subscription.

subscription_type.description: Subscription plan name (e.g. Free, Starter, Growth, Special).

title: Get merchant status
